description: Defines the implementation class 'pucch_allocator_impl' for PUCCH resource allocation in a 5G NR scheduler, including methods for resource management, grant allocation, multiplexing, and PDU filling, with internal structures for tracking grants and resources.

classes.name: pucch_allocator_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the PUCCH allocator interface managing resource allocation, multiplexing, and grant management for UEs.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates internal slot tracking and resets PUCCH resource grid.

methods.name: alloc_common_and_ded_harq_ack
methods.description: Allocates common and dedicated HARQ-ACK resources.

methods.name: alloc_sr_opportunity
methods.description: Allocates SR opportunity for a UE.

methods.name: alloc_csi_opportunity
methods.description: Allocates CSI opportunity for a UE.

methods.name: remove_ue_uci_from_pucch
methods.description: Removes UCI bits for a UE from PUCCH.

methods.name: has_common_pucch_grant
methods.description: Checks if a UE has a common PUCCH grant in a given slot.
